description:
Review Dataset B
	

Anonymous review release of synthetic driving data collected in CARLA 0.9.15
with the PDM-Lite expert.

5,246 quality-filtered recordings, approximately 221 GB.
39 scenario types across Towns 01–05, Town10HD, Town12, and Town13.
768 × 768 DVS events, represented in 50 ms windows.
Includes ego-motion metadata and BEV occupancy labels at 0, +0.5, and +1.0 seconds.
